description: Step 1 of signing_guide, also callable alone. Returns the COMPLETE recovery playbook in-context (or one branch via situation=): BIP39 scan across MetaMask/Ledger Live/Ledger legacy/Trezor/Phantom/Solflare/Trust/Exodus/TronLink and BTC BIP44/49/84/86 paths, missing-word checksum brute force, BIP39 passphrase search, Ethereum keystore v3, 2014-15 presale JSON, Electrum seeds, wallet.dat (btcrecover), blockchain.info legacy, hardware wallets, raw keys, password-guessing from the user's own hints. Reference code runs on the user's machine; SwapChan never receives secrets. Strong warnings against pasting phrases into chat or "recovery service" scams. After addresses: find_money -> verify_tx -> human signs -> broadcast_tx. Result includes `display` markdown with chan images: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

situation.description: Recovery branch: full | seed-phrase | missing-word | passphrase | keystore | presale | electrum | wallet-dat | blockchain-info | hardware | raw-key | password-hints. Default full returns every branch in-context.
